payload.about: PNC Infratech Limited is one of the leading Indian infrastructure companies specializing in road and highway construction. The company provides end-to-end infrastructure solutions including design, engineering, procurement, construction, and O&M services on EPC, DBFOT, HAM, and BOT formats.
payload.vision: To become among the top 3 infrastructure companies in India
strengths: Integrated construction capabilities from mining to commissioning
17+ years track record of timely project completion
Large fleet of sophisticated machinery and plants
